name: cursor-annotate
title: Annotate Cursor
description: A marker pen glides onto the frame and hand-draws a loose loop, an underline, or an arrow around a region, the ink laid exactly under its nib, then lifts and leaves.
when_to_use: Registre HyperFrames (composant) : cursor, motion-primitive, pen, annotation, draw-on, highlight
usage: cd <job> && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.71 add cursor-annotate   (variables : shape, color, target_x, target_y, target_w, target_h)
